text.insert: A sandbox's contents come in three layers: the game image baked once and shared by every sandbox, a per-claim seed pushed at claim creation, and the command and artifact traffic of the run itself. Nothing intelligent enters at any layer — no model access, no knowledge corpora, no secrets, no orchestrator state.
beside it producing the ~2.7 GiB verified bundle. Builds hold until the harness working-tree changes are committed and the Linux musl build of the patched objdiff-cli exists.

entries.note: synthetic single-commit git repo, ~25 MB; the 3.2 GB history stays on the host
Linux dtk, patched objdiff-cli score fork (musl build pending), sjiswrap.exe, optimized wibo 1.2.0-opt1 static i686 — never the configure.py 0.7.0 download
fully built Linux tree: build.ninja, every object, report.json — 125 MB
build-coupled Python tools, plus python3, ninja, git, ripgrep

text.insert: The image is configured and fully built at bake time — MANIFEST.md requires the Linux tree built through

and the all-object target before the snapshot is accepted — so a worker's first unit build is an incremental rebuild in the one-to-five-second range rather than an eighty-plus-second cold configure. The optimized wibo (upstream 1.2.0 plus local patches) halved the full build with every object hash-identical, and runs natively on Linux with no wine fallback.
Claim creation pushes under 10 MB and completes in seconds:

steps.text: Upload the base-revision delta: a git bundle of commits between the image's baked revision and the claim's base revision
kilobytes to megabytes per epoch, and every claim in an epoch pushes the same bundle
Fetch the bundle and check out the base revision detached inside the workspace
Seed report artifacts: report.json (3.4 MB), baseline.json (3.4 MB), report_changes.json (4 KB)
Apply per-session environment: canonical tool paths and PATH, carried by exec sessions rather than baked

text.insert: Inbound, every agent tool call and runner validation command arrives as an exec or file-API call; the prompt and the model never touch the sandbox.

Outbound, command output streams back per call, objdiff verdicts return per attempt, and claim settlement downloads the selected checkpoint's patch and validation artifacts; the workspace itself is never copied out.
